qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and stress granule dynamics
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
rationale: All members concern acute heat/arsenite stress responses (HSF1 activation and attenuation, stress granules, PML bodies, PKR); the HSF1 arm separates it from the stress granule/mRNA-decay confusables and the stress granule arm from the protein-refolding/UPRmt confusables.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and processing
name: tRNA and rRNA modification, largely mitochondrial
rationale: Members are RNA modification (pseudouridylation, methylation, wybutosine) and processing of tRNA/rRNA, most in the mitochondrion with mitoribosome assembly; the mitochondrial emphasis separates it from the nuclear rRNA/snRNA modification confusable, and modification rather than mitochondrial transcription/translation separates it from the broader mitochondrial gene expression confusable.

name: Antral follicle growth, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members describe late ovarian follicle maturation through ovulation and luteinization, distinct from confusables centred on male gonad/gonadotropins, oocyte meiotic maturation, or progesterone synthesis and luteolysis.

core: Inhibition of cell-matrix adhesion and Rac/Rho signaling
name: RPTP-linked inhibition of cell-matrix adhesion and Rac/Rho signaling
rationale: Members restrain focal adhesions, lamellipodia, stress fibres and integrin/Rac/Rho signaling; receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase signaling, homophilic adhesion and invadopodia are what the migration/spreading-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: SHC/FRS2 cascades of FGFR1/3/4, FGFR3 ligand binding
name: FGFR1/3/4 SHC and FRS adaptor signaling to MAPK
rationale: Members are SHC- and FRS-mediated FGFR1/3/4 cascades to MAPK plus FGFR3 and betaKlotho ligand binding, unlike confusables carrying PI3K/PLCgamma branches, FGFR2/FGFR1 ligand binding, or negative FGF regulation.

name: Thiamine and coenzyme A supply for pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members cover PDH-catalysed acetyl-CoA formation and the synthesis of its cofactors CoA (pantothenate) and thiamine diphosphate; the thiamine arm separates it from TCA/NAD/2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables and the PDH/CoA arm from the riboflavin confusable.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures
name: Monocyte/DC surface receptors and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and dendritic cell surface/receptor signatures and DC antigen presentation; CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation distinguishes it from other myeloid signature confusables, and the surface signatures distinguish it from the MHC class II presentation confusable.

core: Mitochondrial amino acid catabolism with protein lipoylation
name: GABA metabolism with lysine and glycine catabolism and lipoylation
rationale: Members are lysine, glycine and GABA catabolism feeding succinyl-CoA, with lipoylation of the dehydrogenase complexes; GABA synthesis and degradation are what all four 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables lack.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis: phosphatidic acid to triacylglycerol
rationale: All members describe synthesis and remodeling of PA, MAG, DAG and TAG, unlike confusables about glycerol/fructose metabolism or lipid droplet storage and adipocyte biology.

qualifier: for decoding fidelity, incl. selenocysteine and readthrough
name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for decoding fidelity
rationale: Members are tRNA charging, wobble/t6A anticodon modification, tRNA splicing, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough, all serving translational fidelity; fidelity, t6A and selenocysteine/readthrough separate it from the tRNA methylation/pseudouridylation and mitochondrial tRNA processing confusables.

qualifier: nuclear pore assembly, RNA and protein traffic
name: Nuclear pore assembly and nucleocytoplasmic RNA and protein transport
rationale: Members concern the nuclear pore complex and export/import of mRNA, ribosomal subunits, tRNA, proteins and inositol phosphates; this separates it from RNA processing/decay, SUMOylation and nuclear-envelope reformation confusables.

qualifier: leucine and isoleucine, with organic acidemias
name: Leucine and isoleucine catabolism and inherited organic acidemias
rationale: Members are leucine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism and their inborn errors (isovaleric acidemia, MCC and beta-ketothiolase deficiency); confusables instead carry valine catabolism or biotin metabolism.

qualifier: BAF and CHD nucleosome organization and chromatin assembly
name: BAF and CHD nucleosome remodeling and chromatin assembly
rationale: Members are BAF complex assembly and CHD1/2 remodelers acting on nucleosome organization and replication-coupled chromatin assembly; the nucleosome/chromatin assembly members are what the BAF-sharing confusables lack.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate/asparagine nitrogen metabolism
rationale: All members concern glutamate/glutamine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism as nitrogen carriers, distinct from TCA/alanine, proline/glycine, dicarboxylate transport and conjugation confusables.

name: TLR7/TLR8 signaling with TASL-dependent IRF5 activation
rationale: All three members are TLR7/8 signaling including SLC15A4:TASL-driven IRF5 activation, whereas confusables cover type I interferon responses, RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, or TLR9/IRF7.

name: IL-17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-17/Th17 signaling plus IL-33, IL-36 and IL-38 signaling; the IL-33 members distinguish it from IL-1/IL-18 and IL-23/antifungal confusables.

name: Exploratory, grooming and psychomotor behavior with amygdala development
rationale: Members are rodent exploratory, swimming, grooming and psychomotor behaviors plus amygdala development; grooming and amygdala development separate it from locomotion/synaptic-transmission and social-behavior confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic domain mutants, not drug resistance
name: KIT signaling and its activating domain mutants
rationale: All members are KIT signaling regulation and signaling by extracellular, juxtamembrane and kinase-domain KIT mutants, unlike confusables about TKI-resistant KIT/PDGFR mutants or FLT3/PDGFR fusions.

name: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle and microtubule severing
rationale: Members are tubulin C-terminal glutamylation/deglutamylation and microtubule severing/depolymerization, distinct from centrosome, chaperonin folding, ciliary axoneme and kinesin transport confusables.

core: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analog drug handling
name: Nucleoside transport, NTP catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and base transport, NUDT/NTP hydrolysis and ADME of thiopurines, ribavirin and abacavir; NTP catabolism and thiopurine metabolism separate it from xenobiotic-transport confusables, transporters from nucleotide-interconversion confusables.

name: Carnitine-dependent mitochondrial beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are stepwise mitochondrial acyl-CoA beta-oxidation, carnitine transport and ketone body synthesis/use; ketone bodies and the beta-oxidation steps are missing from the malonyl-CoA, peroxisomal and fatty acid transport confusables, and the carnitine shuttle from the BCAA confusable.

name: RNA surveillance decay and ribosome-associated protein quality control
rationale: Members are nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay, stalled ribosome rescue and degron-mediated protein degradation; ribosome quality control and degron pathways separate it from splicing/processing, translation initiation and rRNA biogenesis confusables.

core: Mitochondrial organic acid and amino acid conjugation
name: Mitochondrial amino acid conjugation and organic acid metabolism
rationale: Members center on mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with related organic/amino acid metabolism; conjugation distinguishes it from glycine/threonine metabolism, drug ADME and generic organic-acid confusables.

name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members link mineralocorticoid synthesis, aldosterone secretion and response with renal sodium transport and blood pressure; aldosterone separates it from vasopressin/angiotensin and potassium confusables, renal sodium handling from the adrenal steroid confusable.

qualifier: with platelet activation and fibrinolysis inhibition
name: Coagulation cascade, platelet activation and fibrinolysis inhibition
rationale: Members are coagulation initiation, amplification and fibrin formation with platelet degranulation and suppression of plasminogen activation, unlike confusables about fibrin dissolution, VWF defects, contact activation or clotting factor defects.
